messages.content: Hello Morgan. This optional exchange will help the team at Hotel Amour Nice prepare your stay from 2026-11-10 to 2026-11-13. We already have the reservation details shared with the team. You can skip a question or stop at any time. What would you like us to understand about this stay?
I'm visiting for a family matter. I'd rather keep things low-key.
Of course—no need to explain the family matter. What would help keep your stay low-key: a quiet room, minimal interaction, or something else?
Understood—a quiet room is your main priority. Reception will need to confirm what’s available. Is there anything you’d like to add or correct before we leave it there?
Actually, please stop. I don't want my information used to personalise this stay.
Understood—we’ll stop here. The team will receive a minimal record clearly stating that you do not want personalization for this stay.
